theme: Baima & Hongmian, afternoon TBC, Pearl River night cruise

items.title: K Hotel → Guangzhou Railway Station
items.note: Metro ~25 min to Guangzhou Railway Station (广州火车站), or taxi ~20 min.

items.title: Baima Clothing Market (白马服装市场) and Hongmian International Fashion City (红棉国际时装城)
items.note: Both buildings are next to Guangzhou Railway Station. Baima leans mid-to-upper-range workwear for women; Hongmian leans trendy. Many stalls sell single pieces, and bargaining is accepted.
items.tip: Busy on Sunday mornings; backpacks should be worn on the front. Ask the price before deciding.

food.name: Cha chaan teng (茶餐厅) along Liuhua Road (流花路)
food.desc: A bowl of noodles or roast meat rice, quick

food.name: Fast food inside the malls
food.desc: Eat at the nearest mall around Baima and Hongmian

food.name: Flaky pastries from a bakery
food.desc: For a light bite, egg tarts and flaky buns are enough

food.name: LINLEE, Yuexiu Park (林里（越秀公园店）)
food.desc: B1, Chengyi Hui mall on Liuhua Road, by Yuexiu Park Metro exit C; lemon tea after lunch.

items.title: Dinner: near the hotel or Guangzhou Restaurant

food.name: Near the hotel
food.desc: Grandview Mall / Teemall area; back to the hotel, then a taxi to Tianzi Pier

food.name: Guangzhou Restaurant, Wenchang flagship (广州酒家（文昌总店）)
food.desc: 2 Wenchang South Road; Cantonese institution since 1935

food.name: Wenchang chicken, shrimp dumplings, roast meats (文昌鸡、虾饺、烧味)

items.tip: If Guangzhou Restaurant is chosen, the hotel should be left ~17:15 (taxi ~30 min). Afterwards a taxi goes straight to Tianzi Pier (~15 min); no return to the hotel is needed.

items.title: Pearl River night cruise (珠江夜游)
items.note: Tickets and pier should be confirmed in advance.
items.tip: Be at the pier 20 min before departure; it is windy on board, so bring a jacket.

intro:
